data.name: Fairuz
data.gender_notes: Fairuz is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A precious and beautiful gem or jewel. The name Fairuz carries the meaning “Jewel, Precious Gem” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Malay, Arabic, Indonesian. Parents who choose Fairuz usually hope their child will grow to embody jewel, precious gem and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of inner beauty and grace.
data.etymology: Fairuz belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Jewel, Precious Gem.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fairuz total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: فيروز
in_arabic.meaning: حجر أزرق فاتح، نادر، ثمين، لونه أزرق سماوي
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم فيروز مشتق من الكلمة الفارسية فيروزج، وتعني الحجر الكريم الأزرق، و هو حجر ثمين نادر، يمتاز بلونه الأزرق السماوي، و يرمز إلى الثروة و الرفاهية، و يعتبر من الأسماء التي تدل على الجمال و الروعة، و له أهمية كبيرة في الثقافة الإسلامية و العربية.

in_urdu.name: فیروز
in_urdu.meaning: ایک نادر اور قیمتی نیلا پتھر، آسماني نیلا رنگ
in_urdu.long_meaning: فیروز ایک فارسی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے نیلا پتھر یا آسماني نیلا رنگ، یہ ایک ثمين و نادر پتھر ہے جو اپنی خوبصورتی اور قیمتی ہونے کی وجہ سے مشہور ہے، اسلامی ثقافت میں اس نام کی اہمیت اس کی خوبصورتی اور معانی کی گہرائی کی وجہ سے ہے، اور یہ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں ایک مقبول نام ہے.

in_hindi.name: फिरोज
in_hindi.meaning: एक दुर्लभ और मूल्यवान नीला पत्थर, आकाशीय नीला रंग
in_hindi.long_meaning: फिरोज एक नाम है जो फारसी भाषा से आया है, जिसका अर्थ है एक नीला पत्थर या आकाशीय नीला रंग, यह पत्थर अपनी सुंदरता और मूल्य की वजह से प्रसिद्ध है, भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में इस नाम का महत्व इसकी सुंदरता और अर्थों की गहराई की वजह से है, और यह एक पारंपरिक नाम है.

in_pashto.name: فیروز
in_pashto.meaning: نیلی ډبره، یو قیمتي او نادر ډبره
in_pashto.long_meaning: فیروز د پښتو ژبې یو نوم دی چې معنی یې نیلی ډبره یا یو قیمتي او نادر ډبره ده، دا ډبره د خپل ښکلا او قیمتی کیدو له امله مشهوره ده، په افغان او پښتني کلتور کې دا نوم د خپل ښکلا او ماناګانو د ژورتیا له امله مهم دی، او دا د پښتنو مسلمانو لپاره یو مشهور نوم دی.

in_english.name: Fairuz
in_english.meaning: a rare and precious blue stone, sky-blue color
in_english.long_meaning: The name Fairuz is derived from the Persian word for turquoise, a rare and precious blue stone, symbolizing wealth, beauty, and spirituality, with roots in Arabic and Islamic tradition, reflecting a rich history and cultural significance across Muslim communities, particularly in the Middle East and South Asia.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Fairuz" holds a significant cultural impact, especially within the Arab world, as it conveys a sense of beauty, elegance, and rarity. In Arabic, "Fairuz" means "precious" or "rare," and it reflects the idea of having a unique and valuable identity. This name is often used for individuals whom others view as having exceptional talents, achieving remarkable success, or simply being a beautiful and precious addition to the world.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, "Fairuz" has deeper meanings that transcend the physical realm. In Islamic tradition, it can symbolize the preciousness and worth of each soul sent by Allah to this world. Each soul is a divine gift, and it is believed that Allah is always present within every person, making every life unique and priceless. The name "Fairuz" can serve as a reminder of the inherent spiritual worth of every individual and can inspire one to live a life that reflects this preciousness. Thus, having the name "Fairuz" can foster a sense of self-worth, self-appreciation, and a connection to the divine.
